maneder.no: Kaldt i Hunza, minusgrader om natta. Khunjerab-passet stengt.
maneder.en: Cold in Hunza, sub-zero nights. Khunjerab Pass closed.

maneder.no: Kaldt og stille. Flyene til Gilgit innstilles ofte.
maneder.en: Cold and quiet. Flights to Gilgit often cancelled.

maneder.no: Mildere. Blomstringen starter i slutten av måneden.
maneder.en: Milder. Blossom starts at the end of the month.
Pleasant, green. Khunjerab Pass opens 1 May.

maneder.no: Varmt i Gilgit, behagelig i Hunza. Mange innenlandsturister.
maneder.en: Hot in Gilgit, pleasant in Hunza. Many domestic tourists.

maneder.no: Varmest i dalbunnen; ras kan stenge Karakoram Highway. Skoleferie.
maneder.en: Hottest in the valleys; landslides can close the Karakoram Highway. School holidays.
As July. Trekking to base camps.

maneder.no: Klart, kjølig. Høstfarger sent i måneden (se Vinduer).
maneder.en: Clear, cool. Autumn colours late in the month (see events).
Cold at night. Khunjerab closes 30 Nov.
